art-cover: Placeholder cover for games without one
delete-body: This removes {id}.zip from the themes folder and can't be undone. If it is the server's theme, the server switches to RomM default; browsers that picked it follow the server's theme.
folder-not-mapped: The themes folder ({path}) isn't mapped to a folder on the host, so added packs and this setting are lost when the container is recreated.
folder-not-writable: The themes folder ({path}) is read-only, so the selection can't be saved.
guide-link: How to create a theme pack
hidden: {name} is hidden; Restore built-in packs brings it back
hide-body: Built-in packs stay in the image, so {id} is hidden for everyone instead, including after upgrades. Restore built-in packs brings it back.
load-failed: Could not load the theme packs
own-choice: This browser uses its own theme choice. Open the theme picker and choose "Server's theme" to follow this setting.
preview-hint: Opens RomM with this theme in a new tab without saving anything
random-description: A different theme on every page load, from {n} choice | A different theme on every page load, from {n} choices
random-unavailable: Random has nothing to draw from. Include RomM default or another group of themes.
refresh: Reload the list from the themes folder
rename-body: The new name shows in Branding and the theme picker. The pack keeps its id, so the server's theme and browsers' choices still work.
replace-body: {name} has the same id as a pack that is already installed. Replacing it keeps the id, so anyone using that pack gets the new version.
restore-failed: Could not restore the built-in packs
restored: The built-in packs are all shown again
saved: Theme saved and packs reloaded. Reload the page to see the change.
stock-description: RomM's own look, with no theme applied
subtitle: Choose the theme this server shows. A theme pack is a .zip file: upload one above, or add it to the themes folder mapped into the container, and it is checked before it can be used. The theme selected here applies globally to all users.
title: Server theme
upload-hint: A pack as one .zip file, up to {mb} MB. It is checked before anything is installed.
upload-too-large: Theme packs can be at most {mb} MB
